p.src: 1  “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.

en: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.
u.src: 1  “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.

p.src: 2  The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.

en: The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.
u.src: 2  The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I discipline all of them.

p.src: 3  I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.

en: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.
u.src: 3  I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.

p.src: 4  Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know the LORD.

en: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know the LORD.
u.src: 4  Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God, for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know the LORD.

p.src: 5  The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.

en: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.
u.src: 5  The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.

p.src: 6  They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.

en: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.
u.src: 6  They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD, but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.

p.src: 7  They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.

en: They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
u.src: 7  They are unfaithful to the LORD; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.

p.src: 8  “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!

en: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!
u.src: 8  “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!

p.src: 9  Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.

en: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
u.src: 9  Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.

p.src: 10  The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

en: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
u.src: 10  The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

p.src: 11  Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.

en: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
u.src: 11  Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment, because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.

p.src: 12  Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

en: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.
u.src: 12  Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

p.src: 13  “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.

en: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
u.src: 13  “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.

p.src: 14  For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.

en: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.
u.src: 14  For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.

p.src: 15  I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”

en: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”
